document.title: Eval: score part decisions with partsTogether and partsApart
document.summary: Eval cases can name files that must share a part or sit in different parts, and two cases use it.

groups.title: Part-level expects
groups.summary: `case.ts` accepts `partsTogether` and `partsApart`, and `runDeterministicChecks` in `checks.ts` scores them like `together` and `apart`, but per part. A group with no `part` counts as one unnamed story, so a one-story review fails every `partsApart` pair.

attention.note: `unheldPaths` fails a part expect when no group holds one of its paths, while group-level `apart` passes in that case. A pair on a lockfile such as `pnpm-lock.yaml`, which sits in no group, therefore fails every run instead of passing for free. Decide whether a case author should get that failure or a silent pass.

fileNotes.scripts/eval/case.ts: Adds both fields; `pathPair` now types `apart` too.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/checks.ts: A file split across groups counts in each of their parts.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/checks.test.ts: Covers a split `package.json`, an unheld lockfile, and a one-story review.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/result.ts: Prints `partsApart k/n` only when the case sets it.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/graders.test.ts: Fixtures get zero counts; one test checks the printed `partsApart 2/3`.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/report.test.ts: The shared fixture gets the four zero counts.

groups.title: Expects for two cases
groups.summary: cigster-99 keeps the audit report and the QR hook fix out of the living-room story part, and vitadeck-150 keeps its five fixes in five parts. Each `expected.md` Notes bullet says what the pairs hold and what stays open.

attention.note: Only part decisions that `expected.md` states with no alternative are encoded. The cigster-99 page objects, the harness, and the dependency refresh get no part expect, and vitadeck-144 gets none, because its `expected.md` allows zero to eight parts.

fileNotes.eval/cases/cigster-99/expected.md: The Notes now say the QR fix is always its own part.
fileNotes.eval/cases/vitadeck-150/case.json: Ten fix pairs; `parts.min` moves from 4 to 5.
fileNotes.eval/cases/vitadeck-150/expected.md: Names the five fix files the pairs use.

groups.title: Eval docs
groups.summary: `docs/eval.md` and `eval/review-criteria.md` list the two new expects with the existing ones.

fileNotes.docs/eval.md: Adds the unnamed-story rule and cigster-99 `partsApart` to the flaky list.
fileNotes.eval/review-criteria.md: Says the pairs come from decisions with no alternative.

commits.subject: Eval: score part decisions with partsTogether and partsApart
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
A case could only give a count range for parts, so part choices were judged by run-to-run agreement, which also punishes variation the case allows. partsTogether and partsApart name the paths that must share a part or sit in different parts. A group with no part sits in one unnamed story, as in the schema's dependsOn rule. A path no group holds fails, so a lockfile probe cannot pass for free.

cigster-99 keeps the audit, the QR hook fix, and the dependency refresh (probed by .nvmrc) out of the living-room story. vitadeck-150 keeps its five fixes in five parts. The page objects, the harness, and all of vitadeck-144 stay open.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
